prompt: A quantity shrinks by $20\%$ each year. What factor do you multiply by each year? (Write it as a decimal.)
hint: Losing 20% means you KEEP the rest. What percent is left?

hints.text: Losing 20% means you KEEP the rest. What percent is left?

explanation: "Down 20%" means you keep $100\% - 20\% = 80\%$ of the amount.
So each year you multiply by 0.80. (Never multiply by 0.20 — that is what you LOSE.)

alternativeExplanations.title: Test it on $100
steps: Start with $100. Losing 20% takes away $20, leaving $80.

alternativeExplanations.title: Pizza picture
steps: Cut the amount into 5 equal slices. Losing 20% means one slice disappears.
Four of five slices remain: 4/5 = 0.80 of the amount each year.
